assembly.referencePolicy: Only publicReference/publicReferences objects designate published companion links. assembly.qualification: Publication wrapper and explicit links are new; original execution dates, engine/index lineage and observations are preserved. Source documents are untouched.

comparisonSummary.methodology: Three completed repeatable verification runs precede representative exact node/edge SQL comparison and exhaustive bounded classification. SQL opens disposable DB+WAL copies only. No source reads, index lifecycle calls, corpus edits or semantic-correctness inference.

limits.scope: JS heap is not total RSS; snapshot hashing/copying are byte-bounded, not covered by helper timeouts. At most one pair of temporary copies exists at a time.

comparisonSummary.benchmarkCaps: Caps are read from each process record, including values above 600 seconds. They do not change the three-completed-run qualification. The helper timeout is a separate diagnostic limit.
comparisonSummary.engineIdentityQualification: Run engine directory labels and corpus revisions are retained; frozen engine content seals and code revisions must be supplied separately by the campaign record. No engine files are hashed here.

comparisonSummary.scopeCaveat: Skipped or capped pairs have no semantic-parity result. Classified differences require independent source/ToolHandler review; this script performs neither.

newHlsEdgeDelta.methodology: Exact full semantic projections: all node columns except updated_at; edges exclude surrogate id. Every added/removed identity and every modified same-identity row is listed. Edge identity is source,target,kind,IFNULL(line,-1),IFNULL(col,-1). Source-location groups do not assert one-to-one retargeting or correctness. Metadata fields outside a small public identity whitelist and source-bearing node fields retain comparison hashes only. No corpus source was read. No integrity/page scan is run here.

sourceReviewReuse.method: JSON-only equality checks of recorded fullNodeHash, edgesHash, node/edge counts, corpus pins, and every classified delta record. No database, source file, ToolHandler, process measurement or new hash computation.
sourceReviewReuse.engineIdentityQualification: Identities are recorded evidence, not independently rehashed in this task; equality transfer is established from graph/source records.

fourHistoricalKickCalls.basis: Exact retained identities on selected19; all37 additions-only previous→current20; equality of selected19/current20 whole semantic graphs.

limitations: Evidence reuse is limited to these pinned normal-corpus graph deltas; it does not prove whole-graph precision or recall.
Recorded semantic fingerprints exclude updated_at and edge surrogate IDs; semantic metadata/provenance are included. Physical DB bytes need not match.
No new source review or compiled CPP matrix was performed; prior reviews retain their original limitations.
The two Pandoc combinator calls remain heuristic; source support does not establish runtime execution.
No GHC conclusions or performance conclusions are derived from this record.
